## About Me

Welcome to my academic website!

I am **Samuel Bonney**, a graduate student in Applied Statistics at [Illinois State University](https://illinoisstate.edu/).

I earned my Bachelor of Arts in Mathematics and Statistics from the [University of Ghana](https://www.ug.edu.gh/) and am currently pursuing my Master of Applied Statistics at Illinois State University.

My academic interests center on the application of statistical methods to real-world problems. I am particularly interested in statistical modeling, spatial statistics, nonparametric methods, statistical computing, data science, and public health applications.

I enjoy using statistical theory, computation, and visualization to explore complex data, identify meaningful patterns, and communicate results in a clear and practical way.

## Research Interests

- Applied Statistics
- Statistical Modeling
- Spatial Statistics
- Nonparametric Statistics
- Statistical Computing
- Data Science
- Machine Learning
- Public Health Analytics
